PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Harvard Computer Science graduate with 5+ years of experience in administration, customer service, and office management. Combines technical expertise with exceptional organizational and communication skills to optimize office operations. Proven track record in curriculum development, documentation management, and providing high-quality administrative support in academic and professional environments.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Office Software

  • MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
  • Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar)

Administrative Skills

  • Office Administration & Coordination
  • Documentation & Data Entry
  • Scheduling & Calendar Management

Communication

  • Email & Phone Correspondence
  • Reception & Client Interaction
  • Multilingual: English, Urdu, Hindi, Punjabi

Other

  • Computer Science Knowledge
  • Confidentiality & Records Management
  • Problem-solving & Analytical Thinking

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Program Facilitator & Curriculum Support Administrator

Aug 2022 – May 2024
Milton AcademyMilton, MA, USA
  • Developed and implemented Computer Science curriculum for 100+ high-school students, resulting in a 25% increase in student engagement and participation.
  • Managed 20+ daily inquiries from students, parents, and faculty, maintaining a 98% satisfaction rate through prompt and thorough responses.
  • Organized digital and physical materials for 5 different courses, improving resource accessibility and reducing preparation time by 30%.
  • Proactively identified and resolved classroom issues, reducing disruptions by 40% and creating a more productive learning environment.

Administrative Support Specialist

Aug 2019 – Jan 2020
DignoscoLahore, Pakistan
  • Processed and managed 50+ applications daily with 99% accuracy, ensuring compliance with strict documentation requirements and deadlines.
  • Organized and facilitated 15 weekly preparation sessions for groups of 20-30 participants, improving information retention by 35%.
  • Created standardized documentation templates that reduced processing time by 20% and improved consistency across all applications.

Office Administrator

Aug 2017 – Aug 2019
Harvard Art MuseumsCambridge, MA, USA
  • Managed financial transactions totaling $50,000+ monthly, including donation receipts and billing inquiries with 100% accuracy.
  • Served as primary point of contact for 30+ daily visitors and callers, providing information and directing inquiries to appropriate departments.
  • Maintained confidential records for 1,000+ museum donors and members, ensuring data security and GDPR compliance.
  • Streamlined mail distribution process, reducing sorting and delivery time by 25% across 5 museum departments.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science

Graduated: May 2022
Harvard CollegeCambridge, MA, USA
